tagline: Providing vessel refueling services and sustainable fuel solutions across 70+ major ports globally
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI demonstrates Banle's leadership position with the world's largest shipping companies. Serving 9 of the top 12 container carriers, which control 60% of global container capacity, validates the business model and trust from key industry players.

kpis.name: Top container liners served (top 12)
kpis.explanation: Number of companies among the world's 12 largest container shipping lines served by Banle.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, Banle served 9 of the world's top 12 container shipping lines, which together account for nearly 60% of global container fleet capacity, confirming its position as a regional and global leader.
kpis.signal: Partner to nearly 60% of global container fleet capacity

kpis.name: Global network ports
kpis.explanation: Number of ports where Banle facilitates vessel refueling services across five continents.
kpis.description: As of April 2026, Banle's supply network expanded to approximately 70+ ports across Asia Pacific, Europe, Australia, Africa and Central America, including major hubs in China, Belgium, India, Malaysia, Netherlands, Panama, Philippines, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey and Vietnam.
kpis.signal: Expanded from 36 ports at IPO in March 2023 to 70+ ports by April 2026

kpis.name: Biofuel services available
kpis.explanation: Number of key ports where B24 biofuel bunkering services are available.
kpis.description: B24 biofuel bunkering services available in Hong Kong, Port Klang (Malaysia), Nansha, Singapore, Shekou and Yantian. The B24 blend comprises 76% conventional fuel and 24% UCOME, providing approximately 20% greenhouse gas emissions reduction compared to traditional marine fuels.
kpis.signal: Positioned as pioneer in sustainable marine fuels across Asia Pacific

kpis.name: Sustainability certifications
kpis.explanation: Number of international sustainability certifications and recognitions obtained.
kpis.description: Banle holds ISCC EU and ISCC Plus certifications (secured in early 2023) and was awarded the EcoVadis Silver Medal in December 2025, placing it among the top 15% of assessed organizations globally for performance across environment, labor, human rights, ethics and sustainable procurement.
kpis.signal: Recognized among top 15% globally for environmental and social performance

kpis.name: Top 5 customers revenue share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue contributed by the five largest customers.
kpis.description: For fiscal year 2025, the five largest customers (two Taiwanese companies, one Malaysian company, one French company and one Irish company) contributed 60.0% of total revenue, down from 67.2% in 2024 and 70.3% in 2023, reflecting successful diversification efforts and reduced business risk.
kpis.signal: Declining concentration demonstrates successful customer diversification

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last four reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $0.538 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last four reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net loss of $0.003 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last four reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating loss of $0.002 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Biofuel volume growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year increase in biofuel sales volume reflecting growing market demand.
kpis.description: Biofuel sales volume increased by 7.1% year-on-year in fiscal 2025, demonstrating growing market acceptance and Banle's successful penetration of the sustainable marine fuel segment despite broader industry headwinds.
kpis.signal: Accelerating adoption of sustainable fuel alternatives

kpis.name: LNG bunkering launch
kpis.explanation: Entry into LNG supply services marking expansion into alternative marine fuels beyond biofuels.
kpis.description: In December 2025, Banle facilitated Xiaomo Port's inaugural LNG bunkering operation, supporting a vessel operated by a major electric vehicle manufacturer in collaboration with a Chinese national energy supplier. This marked Banle's initial entry into LNG supply services, complementing existing biofuel portfolio.
kpis.signal: Strategic diversification into emerging alternative fuel segment

kpis.name: Sales volume growth
kpis.explanation: Percentage increase in sales volume despite declining revenue due to lower commodity prices.
kpis.description: Despite an 8.0% year-on-year increase in sales volume in fiscal 2025, total revenue declined 9.1% year-on-year, primarily due to lower global oil prices (crude oil down 16.9% and Brent crude down 14.1% year-on-year). Volume growth was driven by strategic network expansion, new customer acquisition and deeper penetration with existing customers.
kpis.signal: Operational momentum driven by network expansion and customer acquisition

kpis.name: EcoVadis global ranking
kpis.explanation: EcoVadis global ranking among assessed organizations for environmental and social performance.
kpis.description: Awarded the EcoVadis Silver Medal in December 2025, placing Banle among the top 15% of assessed organizations globally for performance across environment, labor and human rights, ethics and sustainable procurement, validating its commitment to corporate responsibility.
kpis.signal: International recognition of comprehensive sustainability performance

risks.title: Supplier permit dependency
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned centrally in the 20-F, strong language ("could result in supply disruptions, increased costs, or reputational harm"), stable trend, critical regulatory category for maritime logistics operations.

risks.title: Biofuel regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: High placement in text, alarming language ("adversely affect", "operational disruptions or liabilities"), increasing trend with biofuel expansion, strategic category for the company's future.

risks.title: High customer concentration
risks.score_rationale: Precise data provided (60-70% of revenue), concerned language ("adversely affect"), stable trend despite slight improvement, major structural risk to profitability.

risks.title: Price competition
risks.score_rationale: Key position in document, direct language ("undercut marine fuel prices", "shortfall in our revenue"), stable trend, recurring risk in a low-margin sector.

risks.title: Supplier credit dependency
risks.score_rationale: Central and repeated mention, strong language ("working capital would be insufficient", "adversely affected"), stable trend, critical risk related to operational cash flow despite exclusion of generic liquidity risks.

risks.title: Geopolitical disruptions in the Gulf
risks.score_rationale: Specific detail on Strait of Hormuz, alarming language ("materially disrupt", "immediate and severe consequences"), increasing trend in 2026, direct impact on shipping routes and costs.

risks.title: Regulatory changes on permits
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention, preventive language ("adversely affect", "suspend our operations"), stable trend, systemic risk tied to evolving regulatory requirements.

risks.title: Risk of non-renewal of Labuan license
risks.score_rationale: Strong geographic and legal specificity, explicit reference to Malaysian legal framework, concerned tone, stable trend, key risk for core operations.

ai_positioning.summary: Banle has begun exploring AI applications for future automation and decision-making enhancements, though current AI deployment remains limited to internal process improvements. The company upgraded backend systems with real-time order tracking, data analytics and workflow automation to streamline operations, with data-driven analytics integrated into credit risk assessment frameworks.
evidence: Upgraded back-end systems implementing real-time order tracking, data analytics and workflow automation
Deployed resources to explore AI applications for future automation and decision-making enhancements
Integrated data-driven analytics into credit risk assessment framework to monitor supplier and customer payment histories, market fluctuations and transactional behaviors
Focus on IT strategy for internal process improvements rather than customer-facing AI solutions
